criteria.requirement: Fix Binder.install(ModuleSubclass) through the owning Injector.create_object before normal module invocation, honoring existing constructor injection rather than direct module(). Preserve explicit module instances and configuration functions without reconstructing them, allow existing parent bindings and never assume bindings declared later by that same module are already available. Keep missing unannotated/uninjected parameters and original construction/configuration exceptions visible; prove actual constructor count and installed values.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
